map.→ 打开活动风险评估（概率/影响）工具: -> Open the event risk assessment (probability/impact) tool
map.为什么用 概率×影响 而不是相加？: Why use probability x impact instead of adding them?
map.大型活动筹备时，对安全、财务、声誉、运营、法律合规 5 类风险各估概率（1~5）: When planning a large event, estimate probability (1-5) and impact (1-5) for five risk categories - safety, finance, reputation, operations, and legal compliance - and rank the risk value by probability x impact.
map.把风险值 ≥10 的项计入「高风险项」，作为必须买保险/设应急岗的红线。: Count items with a risk value of 10 or above as high-risk items, a hard line that demands insurance or an emergency post.
map.概率和影响都填 5 分风险值 25，是不是直接取消活动？: With both probability and impact at 5 the risk value is 25 - does that mean cancelling the event outright?
map.横向比较 5 类风险，锁定风险值最高的一类优先制定预案。: Compare the five risk categories side by side and lock onto the one with the highest risk value to write a contingency plan first.
map.活动风险评估工具按概率（1-5）与影响（1-5）矩阵量化活动风险等级，输出高优先: The event risk assessment tool quantifies the event risk level on a probability (1-5) by impact (1-5) matrix and outputs the high priority items. Suitable for contingency planning for launch events, road shows and similar activities.
map.相乘能区分「高概率低影响」与「低概率高影响」——两者相加可能相同，但后者一旦触发: Multiplication distinguishes high-likelihood low-impact from low-likelihood high-impact - the two can sum to the same value, but the latter has severe consequences when it triggers. Multiplication gives extreme impact inherently more weight, which better matches risk management intuition (such as tail catastrophe events). If your system prefers addition, treat the result as a reference and compute separately.
map.舆情情感倾向简单分析（词频）: Simple sentiment tendency analysis of public opinion (word frequency)
map.风险值 25 触发「极高风险、建议取消或重大调整」的提示，但是否取消还要看该风险: A risk value of 25 triggers the "very high risk, cancellation or major adjustment recommended" warning, but whether to cancel still depends on whether the risk can be mitigated. For example, a safety risk of (5,5) falls to a risk value of 10 if capacity limits, screening and an on-site medical team push likelihood down to 2. The tool gives the risk level with no intervention, to drive contingency planning rather than act as a single veto.
map.：5 类风险（安全风险、财务风险、声誉风险、运营风险、法律合规风险），每类各填概: : five risk categories (safety, financial, reputation, operational, and legal compliance). Fill in likelihood (1-5) and impact (1-5) for each; risk value = likelihood x impact, and the overall risk takes the maximum across the five. Grades: a maximum risk value of 16 or above is very high risk, 10 or above high, 5 or above medium, below 5 low; items with a risk value of 10 or above count as high-risk items.
map.：某音乐节：安全(5,5)=25、财务(4,3)=12、声誉(3,4)=12、运: : a music festival: safety (5,5) = 25, finance (4,3) = 12, reputation (3,4) = 12, operations (4,3) = 12, legal (2,3) = 6 -> the maximum of 25 is graded very high risk, with 4 high-risk items (safety, finance, reputation, operations), requiring cancellation or major adjustment. By contrast an internal training event: safety (3,3) = 9, finance (2,2) = 4, reputation (3,2) = 6, operations (2,3) = 6, legal (2,2) = 4 -> the maximum of 9 is graded medium risk with 0 high-risk items, so the routine contingency plan is enough.
